coaching.headline: Down 13-35 in objective takes with both Primal Fangtooths gone, the team won it anyway on two late teamfights — 3-0 at 36.2 a body down and 4-0 at 38.9.
coaching.team: For 35 minutes the map was theirs — Fangtooth at 9, 16 and 23, Primal Fangtooth at 29 and 35, Genesis Core and Orb Prime at 30 — largely because our fights kept starting without the whole five: the 0-4 at their Fangtooth at 22.9 happened while the winning offlane stayed home, and the 28.4 loss at Primal Fangtooth came with a man up. What saved it was finally grouping: 3-0 at their river at 36.2 and 4-0 at our outer tower at 38.9, cashed into Genesis Core at 37 and Orb Prime at 38. The Fey put out 85k magical damage and only one of five of us bought magic resist — the cleaner itemization answer ends this game much earlier.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 36.2 river fight — 3-0 while outnumbered four to five — flipped the map, and the 4-0 at our outer tower at 38.9 closed out a game they had led since minute 9.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Phase carried the sustain war: 32,801 healing, 15 wards and a 0/3/14 line against a Mourn comp. The film's one repeated flag is attachment — alive but absent from the fights at 14, 19.2, 28.4 and 36.2; a link support's healing only counts when it is standing in the fight.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Gideon led our damage with 52,680 and won the mid lane early against an 85k Fey, but the 17.5 solo catch by The Fey cost the 17.9 outer tower, and at 14 he was ahead in lane while a 0-2 was lost nearby. Winning mid is a license to shove and arrive — the late-game version of him that joined the 38.9 fight is the one the team needed at 22.9.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Sparrow was the win condition made real — 12/5/4, Mourn dead to him five times, and the closing spree from 36.2 through 39.8 that took the game. The 28.4 death at their Primal Fangtooth stands out as the one bad entry: the team had a man up and still went 0-3.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim won the offlane against Crunch all game and tanked 69,058 damage with 52,940 mitigated — genuine frontline work with no armor items into a three-physical comp. The two costly moments were staying home while 22.9 went 0-4 at their Fangtooth, and the 35.5 solo catch by Mourn that forced the team to fight 36.2 a body down.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Khaimera soaked a game-high 82,832 damage and put 22,983 into objectives, but nine deaths was the tax — the film ties his falls at 15.7, 19.2, 24.7, 28.4 and 34.3 directly to lost towers and Fangtooths. The 19.2 and 34.3 deaths were two-man fights into Scarlett and The Fey with three teammates alive elsewhere; those are fights to decline.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.8s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal

ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate
